verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items address data retention policies, deletion controls, data export, or GDPR/CCPA-style deletion APIs for contacts/events. The docs focus on sending email, API/SDK usage, and migration, with nothing on how a user or agent controls retention or deletion of stored data. Missing for 10: documented data retention policy, contact/event deletion API or endpoint, data export/erasure workflow, and any privacy compliance certification.
